def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    # A full-length 2 line marks the side opposite the line to be drawn.
    full_row = next((r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for c in range(w))), None)
    full_col = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))), None)
    pts = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != 2]
    if not pts:
        return out
    if full_row is not None:
        rmin, rmax = min(x[0] for x in pts), max(x[0] for x in pts)
        r = rmin - 1 if full_row > rmax else rmax + 1
        if 0 <= r < h:
            out[r] = [8] * w
    elif full_col is not None:
        cmin, cmax = min(x[1] for x in pts), max(x[1] for x in pts)
        c = cmin - 1 if full_col > cmax else cmax + 1
        if 0 <= c < w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][c] = 8
    return out
